verdict: You decide, the agent drafts, and a panel of reviewers argues before anything merges.

recommendations.title: Start a new session per ticket
recommendations.summary: Resume a session only to finish its own task; hand off with /handoff instead of reopening it for the next ticket.

recommendations.title: Teach the cd rule in the system prompt once
recommendations.summary: One AGENTS.md line about commands already running in the working directory prevents most cd guard blocks.

recommendations.title: A standing review panel for every MR you open
recommendations.summary: Run the review swarm in a GitLab job and post findings as a draft note to approve with /mr-review.

recommendations.title: A design memory across sessions
recommendations.summary: An extension that injects the ADRs relevant to the files being edited, so designs and code stay aligned.

carried.evidence: The squash prompt has capped the body at 6 lines since clanker-stuff commit 0a8e7b5 on 13 Oct; before it, seven runs ended with a request for a shorter message.
carried.effect: No requests for a shorter message in the three runs since.

carried.evidence: voucherpro-debug still ends without a follow-ups list, and the memory-leak fix found in session [[S261008-2331]] reached neither a ticket nor a commit.
No session since 13 Oct built the intent check; design rulings still live only in chat. Go big picks the idea up again with a smaller first step.
